title: Channel index out of bounds for n_channels < 3
description:
File: rust/lichen-core/src/lib.rs
Line: 102

synchronized_hop_channel clamps n_channels to minimum 3, then returns 1 + (h % 2) which can be channel 2. When n_channels=2, only channels 0 and 1 exist, so returning 2 is invalid. Same issue exists at line 165 in select_channel_with_gnss hash-based path.
